author: Forbes
description:
AI is no longer just a smart chatbot—it’s rapidly evolving into fleets of autonomous agents capable of taking action on their own. But as these systems gain independence, how much control are organizations actually willing to surrender? In this episode of In The Room: Securing The Enterprise, host Katharine Schwab sits down with CIOs Rishi Tripathi and Paul Beswick to untangle the massive economic potential and deep corporate anxiety surrounding AI autonomy.

author: Forbes
description:
IN SEPTEMBER 2025, staff from an environmental nonprofit descended on Trump National Golf Club in Jupiter, Florida. Over three days, they looked for the kind of things that excite naturalists—bird species, bat calls, plant varieties—then recorded their discoveries in a 180-page report. It barely mentioned the thing they were really looking for: a tax break for Donald Trump.

The president needed one, desperately. Trump’s return to the White House, and his eagerness to profit from it, yielded $1.4 billion of crypto earnings in 2025. His real-estate empire supplied more than $200 million on top of that, according to Forbes calculations. The president’s projected tax bill snowballed to over $500 million.
